description: Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; Single and two storey side to rear extension; Single storey rear extension; Alterations to roof to form rear dormer, Roof lights in front roof slope; Installation of solar panels on side roof slope; External alterations; Patio to rear (Demolition of attached garage and side extension)
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
proposed alterations to the roof and first-floor side extension, specifically the change of gradient in the roof slope,&nbsp; by reason of &nbsp;its unsympathic design would unbalance the
pair of semi-detached properties and result in an incongruous form of
development which would fail to respect the character, composition and design of the host dwellinghouse and neighbouring properties.
The proposal would therefore result in a detrimental impact to the character and
appearance of the subject dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the area,
contrary to the high quality design aspirations of National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D.1, D.11 and D.12) of the London Plan (2021),
Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM1 of the
Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
